prompt: Produce an implementation-ready Python 3.11 design for a dependency-aware in-memory job runner. Define a small public API for jobs and results, validate duplicate IDs, unknown dependencies and cycles, execute only dependency-ready jobs with bounded parallelism, propagate failed-dependency skips, and provide pytest test cases. The deliverable must be concrete enough for another engineer to implement without making architecture decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Defines explicit Job, JobResult and runner public interfaces with typed fields and status values.
Specifies deterministic validation for duplicate IDs, unknown dependencies, self-dependencies and dependency cycles.
Uses topological execution waves so only ready jobs run concurrently and max_workers is enforced.
Defines failure and skipped-dependent behavior without allowing blocked jobs to execute.
Provides concrete pytest cases covering success, bounded concurrency, unknown dependency, cycle, failure propagation and deterministic result ordering.
